code:
type Transfer @entity(immutable: true) {
  id: ID!
  from: Bytes!
  to: Bytes!
  value: BigInt!
  blockNumber: BigInt!
  blockTimestamp: BigInt!
  transactionHash: Bytes!
}
caption: @entity marks a GraphQL type as its own indexed, queryable table.
No immutable flag — every new Transfer updates this entity's fields.
@derivedFrom computes the relationship — nothing to maintain by hand.

subtitle: Turning a raw event into one of these entities.
